hardware.gpu: 8 x NVIDIA L4 (SM89), no cross-NUMA peer access
hardware.cpu: Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU @ 2.20GHz; 96 logical CPUs, two NUMA nodes

method.timer: original slowest-rank CUDA event interval; includes other ranks fill/verify host-submission gaps; no deliberate inter-call idle
method.gpu_exclusivity: compute processes checked before and after every performance sweep; occupied GPUs abort the script
method.fallback: NCCL P2P default on within each NUMA group; SHM across NUMA; only HOME/PATH plus explicit CUDA/NCCL library paths and Socket/no-plugin/IB-disable environment inherited
method.sweep_range_definition: min/max of those sweep medians, not confidence intervals

variants.serial: current binary with the same cap4/batch options

screen_notes.guard: preliminary duplicate-validation removal while compilation was running; not a final performance claim; the final serial control is authoritative
screen_notes.launch: sleeping launch workers (100-us spin), main CPU 23; SMT sibling 71 conflicts with caller
screen_notes.affinity: 100-us-spin launch workers with main CPU 47; still loses
screen_notes.spin: 2-ms-spin launch workers, main CPU 47; dense small-message screening
screen_notes.small: fixed GPU flat/striped configurations; no best variant per size

cadence.status: diagnostic, separate binary; one sweep per configuration
cadence.insertion: host sleep before fill/start; outside event interval
cadence.conclusion: 5-ms idle lets the 2-ms-spin launchers sleep; adding parallel submission regresses vs hybrid alone. Absolute probe timings are not confirmation-table points.

trace.status: instrumented diagnostics, excluded from performance table
trace.raw_reports: retained under ignored build/rs_submit_20261113; trace manifests and derived analysis archived
trace.observation: 8 spinning launch lanes reduce GPU-start skew; two sleeping NUMA lanes do not. Parallel CUDA API calls do not scale linearly.

validation.auto_checks: all 13 measured winning keys selected; unknown exact 1536 bytes and changed launch setting fall back with no router initialization
validation.sanitizers: native concurrency checks passed; no new sanitizer success claimed

limits: New options are opt-in and require fresh exact local calibration.
Parallel eager launches reserve extra CPUs, spin up to 2 ms and are call-cadence/affinity sensitive.
Parallel launches require explicit streams or cudaStreamLegacy; nullptr and cudaStreamPerThread are rejected.
Small-message GPU progress uses existing GPU rounding, not bitwise hierarchical CPU rounding.
No application or multiprocess drop-in speedup established.
Historical earlier CPU-23 data is separate from this CPU-47 confirmation.

reproduction.scripts: Verbatim originals from experimental/lite/build/rs_submit_20261113. Copy there before executing; choose fresh output names. Old experimental binaries must be reconstructed from their recorded source state; binaries are not committed.
reproduction.build_command: make -C experimental/lite -j2 adaptive-collectives router-checks BUILD=build/rs_submit_20261113 CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-12.9 CUTLASS_HOME=/data/zhongjie/cutlass-v4.5.0 NCCL_HOME=build/nccl-2.28.9

samples: raw samples are losslessly gzip compressed; decompress or open with Python gzip. Every scalar output was checked by the benchmark.
